notes.title: Are You Ready For Arming
notes.notes:
Hello Valuable Gamers,

Action You are looking for is finally came to our game. Now you can create a headgun with 2X gold, 10X Iron, 1X Cable.

Note: This Gun Shots Only when you're focused(hold right click).And This gun uses 2 energy per shot.

Another thing is, we have added enemy creatures. And you can fight with them.We don't have any idea for these enemy's name so we'll find a name as soon as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38463945/3141bb903688d200ece132a5492d3247efc638fd.gif[/img]

And We Will add a  searching function for enemy's when you kill them(this will add some random items to your inventory)

Now your space vehicle won't destroyed when you close your game.It will spawned to your first placed positin.

See you at further updates.

Thanks

Ali Efruz YILDIRIR form Sinaefruz Studios.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello Again.
Today We made update for recipes of some machines.And we started for working on further updates.Please inform us via e-mail or "Report Bug Form" when you see a bug.

In This Update
 - Mine Finder's petrol requirement is 1 now
 - Oil Drill's battery requirement is 1 now.
 - Storage's Energy won't be negative.
 - And other bug fixes.

notes.title: Controller Support Has Arrived
notes.notes:
Hello,

First I Want To Inform You About Problems In Controlling Robot(Especially Building Function)

In game If You Want To Build A Buildable You have To Set Your Slots's Item In Inventory(With 1 Or 2 Buttons On Viewport That Is Near Item You Want To Set) Then You Should Select Slot With 1 or 2 key In Game(not In Inventory). After Setting Slots You Should look To Ground You Want To Build And Press"E" It's Too Basic Isn't It?


Now Let's take a look at this update:
[list]
[*] Firstly You Can Use Controllers(Gamepads) In game But You Can't Use It In Menus For Navigation.
[*] Some Spawning Problems That Looks Weird(Sometimes Mines Spawned On The Tree) Is Fixed.
[*] We Think You Will Understand Our Game Better.
[*] Our Robot ıs Happier Now
[/list]


If We Talk About Updates We Will Make In Further:
[list]
[*]You Will navigate In Menu With Controllers Easily
[*]We Will Fix Some Bugs
[*]and others
[/list]

See You For Now

Ali Efruz Yıldırır From Sinaefruz Studio.
